Oklahoma State ranks 48th on defense, holding its opponents to 35.1%. Oklahoma State is 24th in FBS in red zone defense, allowing opponents to score on 76.2% of red zone trips. Team leaders Oklahoma State Passing: Drew Mestemaker, 2,326 yards, 20 TDs, 6 INTs, 65.7 completion percentage Rushing: Caleb Hawkins, 712 yards on 142 carries, 2 TDs Receiving: Wyatt Young, 639 yards on 36 catches, 6 TDs Iowa State Passing: Jaylen Raynor, 1,107 yards, 7 TDs, 4 INTs, 58.9 completion percentage Rushing: Aiden Flora, 716 yards on 102 carries, 6 TDs Receiving: Omari Hayes, 237 yards on 19 catches, 1 TD Last game Oklahoma State beat Colorado 57-24 on Oct. 24. Raynor threw for 106 yards on 8-of-10 attempts (80.0%) with no touchdowns and no interceptions. Flora carried the ball 12 times for 36 yards, adding three receptions for 15 yards. Vince Benetti recorded 42 yards on three catches. Next game Oklahoma State plays at Kansas State on Nov. 7. Iowa State plays at Baylor on Nov. 7.
